sections.heading: Festival as a cultural meeting point
paragraphs: The 57th IFFI provided the setting for a press discussion around The River Train, an Argentine Spanish-language feature presented in the International Competition section. This connects festival programming with cross-border cinematic exchange. [P1]

sections.heading: Child-centred collaboration
paragraphs: The source reports that the crew adjusted its working methods to the needs and moods of the young performer, keeping the child at the centre of the creative process. This illustrates empathy in production, but the source does not detail formal child-protection procedures. [P1]

sections.heading: What the account does—and does not—show
